title: ISO/IEC 5055:2021 — automated source code quality measures
description: One rule per ISO/IEC 5055 measure, evaluated from the SARIF a free analyser produces. Evolith supplies the CWE→measure translation; the analyser supplies the findings.

notEvaluableHere.why: Evolith has no code parser. Every weakness in this standard is decided by an external analyser, so the COVERAGE of this pack is the coverage of whatever the tenant points it at — not of the 138 weaknesses the standard names. Publishing a per-weakness rule for each would advertise a check nothing performs.
notEvaluableHere.consequence: A green verdict here means the configured analyser found no ISO/IEC 5055 weakness. It does NOT mean the repository is free of them, and this pack is non-blocking for exactly that reason: the tenant decides what its own analyser coverage is worth.
dependsOn: The analyser named in enforce.config (default semgrep p/default), or a SARIF log the tenant already produces.
notEvaluableHere.severityNote: The rules are MUST severity and blocking:false, and the pair is deliberate. MUST is what makes GT-569 emit an advisory when the analyser did not run: without it, a tenant whose scanner is not installed gets `passed` over zero evaluated rules — the exact false assurance this corpus keeps finding. blocking:false is what stops that advisory from failing a build over coverage this pack never claimed to have.

rules.title: ISO/IEC 5055 — Security
rules.description: Weaknesses of the ISO/IEC 5055:2021 Security measure found in this repository by the analyser the tenant configured. The measure covers 74 CWE identifiers; how many of them an analyser can actually decide depends on which one is pointed at, so this rule reports what was FOUND and never claims coverage of the rest.
rules.rationale: ISO/IEC 5055:2021 names 138 structural weaknesses as CWE identifiers across four measures. Evolith does not parse code: it translates the findings of a free analyser (semgrep by default, or any SARIF the tenant already produces) into these measures. Verified on the Evolith Core repository itself, 34 of 75 open CodeQL alerts are weaknesses this standard names.
rules.validationQuery: SARIF findings whose CWE belongs to the ISO/IEC 5055 Security measure.
